name: security-audit
description: Infrastructure security audit plugin derived from a real post-incident engagement (SQLi -> JWT -> cloud API-key theft). 4 skills (recon, exploit lab, live verification, findings reports), 2 agents (security-auditor lead + exploit-lab-operator), 5 commands covering the full audit loop: repo/IaC/git-history recon, CVE/OSV matching, isolated Docker exploit labs with A/B patch verification, non-destructive live-endpoint probe suites, and per-finding report generation.
